claim: `sspf demo` creates a new temporary folder, copies the bundled sample exactly, prints the folder, and runs the real check.
sandbox: fresh working directory; parse the printed temporary path, compare all files with examples, and confirm the working directory stays unchanged

claim: The landing recording shows the current output from the real `sspf demo` command.
sandbox: fresh browser page; execute the real CLI, normalize only its generated temporary path, and compare every output line with the rendered SVG and transcript

claim: The CLI finds missing, extra, renamed, and over-limit keys across every sample destination without changing inputs.
sandbox: bundled multi-environment fixture; parse JSON results and compare every input byte before and after

claim: The CLI rejects assignments, JSON, and lines containing spaces without printing their key or value or writing a report.
sandbox: temporary exports with unique sentinels; inspect stdout, stderr, status, and requested report paths in all output modes

claim: Key files accept blank lines, comments, and documented name characters, and reject unsupported characters.
sandbox: temporary key files; compare commented and stripped reports, then exercise every allowed class and adjacent invalid characters

claim: Block fails on extra keys, warn and allow report without failing, and strict mode fails under all three policies.
sandbox: temporary manifest and export; run the full three-policy matrix with and without strict mode

claim: The CLI exits 0 for pass, 1 for drift, and 2 for invalid input.
sandbox: temporary passing fixture, bundled drift fixture, and missing manifest

claim: The CLI prints terminal, JSON, or GitHub reports and creates a report file only when `--report` is used.
sandbox: fresh directory; exercise all stdout formats, confirm no implicit file, and parse an explicitly requested report

claim: The installed package provides one CLI, needs no service, makes no network calls, and leaves local inputs unchanged.
where: landing facts and scope, README, terms page
sandbox: package and install into a fresh consumer root; run with socket calls blocked and logged, decoy provider credentials, hashed inputs, and an empty output directory

claim: One click from the landing page opens the populated sample report without a provider login.
sandbox: fresh browser page; click the primary landing action and assert the URL, persistent label, realistic findings, limit, and absence of a login field

claim: Browser sample edits reset and clear on refresh without changing real browser data.
where: demo banner, landing page, README, privacy page
sandbox: fresh browser context with real-data sentinels; enter from landing, edit, reset, leave, reload, and inspect cookies and browser databases

claim: The browser demo requests files only from this site and works offline after its first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; record the complete setup, reload, action, and offline flow before checking every request

claim: Secret Sync Preflight is free software under the MIT License.
sandbox: clean checkout; inspect package metadata and the complete license grant

claim: The static build serves its pages with security headers and returns the designed page with HTTP 404 for unknown routes.
sandbox: fresh production site build served locally; inspect response status, headers, metadata, and shared page shell
